feedback.goal: Mirror the PrismDeckJS npm publishing pattern (release-triggered workflow, tag-to-semver versioning, build, npm pack --dry-run verification, npm publish --provenance with NPM_TOKEN) for the three dal-* plugins, plus a CI gate workflow.

acceptance_criteria.statement: .github/workflows/publish.yml maps release tags dal-<pkg>-v<semver> to exactly one plugin publish: version set from the tag, repo build, tarball verification, provenance publish with NPM_TOKEN.
.github/workflows/ci.yml runs the full dal gate on push and PRs.
Plugin package metadata is publish-ready: repository fields present, prepack builds lib via the checked-out typescript entry, and the prepack path is verified locally.
The full local gate stays green.

outcome.summary: GitHub publishing workflow landed following the PrismDeckJS pattern, with the prepack build path verified locally; the gate stays green.

what_worked: The PrismDeckJS conventions transferred one-to-one: release trigger, tag semver validation, --no-git-tag-version, pack dry-run, --provenance with id-token write.
The prepack tsc entry was corrected from the shell shim (.bin/tsc) to the JS entry (typescript/bin/tsc) after a live failure, and re-verified.
what_failed: The first prepack spelling ran node against the .bin shell shim and failed; corrected to the typescript JS entry.

calls.name: workflow-setup
calls.purpose: Add ci.yml and publish.yml plus repository/prepack metadata to the three plugin packages.

calls.name: prepack-verify
calls.purpose: Verify the prepack build path works from a clean plugin directory.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Run the full repository verification gate.

evidence.summary: Release-triggered publish for dal-modes/dal-run-record/dal-improve-tools via tag prefix matching; ci.yml runs pnpm run check on push and PRs.
node ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json builds lib/index.js from the plugin directory.
Typecheck, build, 134 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed.

uncertainty.statement: The workflows cannot run until they exist on GitHub; the release-triggered publish has not been exercised.
uncertainty.resolution: First publish: create a release with tag dal-modes-v0.1.0 after adding the NPM_TOKEN secret to the repository settings.

notes: CI/packaging change only; no runtime behavior or external transfer.
